scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,cyan "npm run dev --workspace backend" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,cyan "npm run start --workspace backend" "npm run start --workspace frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace backend
